problem: Construct a nondegenerate triangle with three prescribed positive side lengths satisfying all three strict triangle inequalities.

proof_idea.original: Place copies of the given lengths on a line, draw circles with two prescribed radii, join an intersection to their centers.
proof_idea.analytic: Use a normalized base from (0,0) to (r,0), with apex x=(r^2+s^2-t^2)/(2r), h=sqrt(s^2-x^2). Positive four-factor discriminant proves h>0; certify two squared distances and actual circle membership before selecting the triangle witness.

# Book I.22: construct a triangle equal to three prescribed nonzero segments.
thm proposition_22:
    ? forall a1, a2, b1, b2, c1, c2 cart(R, R):
        a1 != a2
        b1 != b2
        c1 != c2
        angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2) + angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2) > angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2)
        angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2) + angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2) > angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2)
        angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2) + angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2) > angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2)
        =>:
            exist p, q, w cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_triangle(p, q, w), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(p, q, a1, a2), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(p, w, b1, b2), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(q, w, c1, c2)}
    have r R+ = angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2)
    have s R+ = angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2)
    have t R+ = angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2)
    r + s = angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2) + angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2) > angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2) = t
    r + t = angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2) + angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2) > angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2) = s
    s + t = angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2) + angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2) > angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2) = r
    release thm angle_measure::three_positive_sides_triangle_witness(r, s, t)
    obtain p, q, w from exist aa, bb, cc cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_triangle(aa, bb, cc), geometry::main::distance_sq(aa, bb) = r^2, geometry::main::distance_sq(aa, cc) = s^2, geometry::main::distance_sq(bb, cc) = t^2, cc $in geometry::main::circle(aa, s), cc $in geometry::main::circle(bb, t)}
    release thm angle_measure::segment_length_square_is_squared_distance(a1, a2)
    release thm angle_measure::segment_length_square_is_squared_distance(b1, b2)
    release thm angle_measure::segment_length_square_is_squared_distance(c1, c2)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q) = r^2 = angle_measure::segment_length(a1, a2)^2 = geometry::main::distance_sq(a1, a2)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(p, w) = s^2 = angle_measure::segment_length(b1, b2)^2 = geometry::main::distance_sq(b1, b2)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, w) = t^2 = angle_measure::segment_length(c1, c2)^2 = geometry::main::distance_sq(c1, c2)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(p, q, a1, a2)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(p, w, b1, b2)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(q, w, c1, c2)
    witness exist aa, bb, cc cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_triangle(aa, bb, cc), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(aa, bb, a1, a2), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(aa, cc, b1, b2), $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(bb, cc, c1, c2)} from p, q, w
